name: mackayi
description: Keith MacKay's Claude Code plugin marketplace

plugins.name: sessionstats
plugins.description: Auto stats tracker plugin (total aggregated time/tokens per Claude Code project across sessions/devs)

plugins.name: port-skill
plugins.description: Ports a skill/plugin/slash command between Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity, Gemini CLI

plugins.name: improve-this
plugins.description: Evaluate a project for potential improvements. Strictly evaluate-and-report — never modifies files

plugins.name: url-eval
plugins.description: Scores candidate domain names/URLs across 8 dimensions, checks availability, produces a report

plugins.name: plsfix
plugins.description: Rewrites vague specs/prompts/instructions/textfiles into clear, actionable ones

plugins.name: acem-cost-estimation
plugins.description: (experimental, ymmv) ACEM methodology to estimate AI-agent build cost (time/$) for an existing or planned codebase

plugins.name: wikify
plugins.description: Builds/updates knowledge wiki (augmented Karpathy pattern) + website, knowledge graph, learning plan

plugins.name: readme
plugins.description: Creates/updates comprehensive README.md for project/repo + optional ancillary files & license

plugins.name: bootstrap
plugins.description: Starts a new project from scratch: template copy, README, git/GitHub setup, then guided design and implementation planning

plugins.name: git-release
plugins.description: Preps a project for public GitHub release: MIT license, README/.gitignore checks, remote creation, branch protection, tagged release

plugins.name: pseudocodify
plugins.description: Converts a codebase into language-agnostic pseudocode, for porting to a new language or documenting unfamiliar code

plugins.name: do-retro
plugins.description: Generates/updates a PROJECT_HISTORY.md: git commits, design decisions, every user prompt, plus retroactive-learning hindsight lessons
